name: @tjxjnoobie/strands-bridge
description: Thin shared integration bridge for Strands Agents in Tavall agent products.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:integ:mcp: npm run verify:real-strands && npm run build && node --test test/integ/mcp/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:integ:model: npm run verify:real-strands && npm run build && node test/integ/model/authorized-model-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:integ:codex: npm run verify:real-strands && npm run build && node test/integ/model/codex-cli-model-smoke.mjs
scripts.check:real: npm run check && npm run test:integ:mcp
